reports.notes: Handwritten. The entire street-address block and the phone number are redacted upstream by the county (solid black bars), so residence_city could not be read; the fax field reads 'NONE'. Lines 1 and 7 are slashed-zero glyphs (the filer's zero), transcribed as 0 at medium confidence. Lines 3, 4, 5 and 6 are each written in PARENTHESES as (65.00) - the filer's own notation, reproduced verbatim rather than interpreted; note the filer's figures are internally inconsistent with the form's instructions (line 4 is directed to carry line 1 Column A, which he wrote as zero). Cents are written as a raised superscript '00'. Neither amendment box is marked, so is_amendment is left empty. Page 2 carries the printed header '2014 County Candidate' and a clerk received stamp JUN 17 PM 5:35 appears on the cover.
